redis.persistence: off (--save "" --appendonly no) when started by the harness

notes.timestamps: Producer and worker run in separate processes; worker timestamps are corrected by the measured clock offset (see each scenario.clock).
notes.phases: enqueue = Queue.add; pickup = add resolved → processor start; process = processor body; finalize = processor end → worker completed event (moveToFinished); notify = completed → waitUntilFinished resolved; afterProcess = finalize + notify; overhead = total − process.

A.description: In-process no-op async call; Redis PING round trip on the harness Redis; JSON cost of a ~50 KB ScrapeResult.

B1.description: BullMQ round trip, noop processor, priority 1 (pass 1)

D1.description: BullMQ round trip, noop processor, NO priority (pass 1)

B2.description: BullMQ round trip, noop processor, priority 1 (pass 2)

D2.description: BullMQ round trip, noop processor, NO priority (pass 2)

C.description: BullMQ round trip, processor does worker.ts's Redis traffic (5x updateProgress, 4 SSE publishes, router domain GET/GET/SET, ~50 KB cache + result SETs, ~50 KB return value)

E.description: Worker (drainDelay 5 s BZPOPMIN) and QueueEvents (XREAD BLOCK 10 s) idle before each job; noop processor, priority 1.

F.description: extractContent via the Piscina pool (markdown), small ~1 KB example.com-like page and ~500 KB content page; plus the same implementation on the main thread and its main components.

fifoGated.label: pool small via FIFO gate concurrency 20
pool large via FIFO gate concurrency 5

G.description: tier1Fetch (Impit + fetchWithSafeRedirects) of the local fixture over plain HTTP on loopback. No DNS, no TLS, no internet RTT.

guard.note: DNS latency itself is not measurable offline; verdicts are cached 30 s per hostname (packages/shared/src/net.ts).

Q.description: T1/T2 acceptance decision for each fixture page (threshold 0.55).

signals: Very low visible text (202 chars — likely stub / block page)

I.description: Browser tiers with the worker BrowserPool (Chromium from the local Playwright cache, may differ from the revision patchright pins). Local HTTP fixture: no network RTT, no third-party sub-resources.

H-compact.description: Full worker path, compact page from the local fixture: real SmartRouter (browser tiers disabled), real Piscina extraction, worker.ts Redis traffic; cacheTtl 0 like the tests/perf tier1-example scenario

H-large.description: Full worker path, large page from the local fixture: real SmartRouter (browser tiers disabled), real Piscina extraction, worker.ts Redis traffic; cacheTtl 0 like the tests/perf tier1-example scenario

H-classic.description: Full worker path, small page from the local fixture: real SmartRouter (browser tiers enabled), real Piscina extraction, worker.ts Redis traffic; cacheTtl 0 like the tests/perf tier1-example scenario
